comment: Mock LLM response for General Agent - destination recommendations

destinations.name: Lisbon
destinations.rationale: Combines rich history, world-class food scene, and mild June weather. Affordable destination with excellent walking trails nearby.

destinations.name: Porto
destinations.rationale: Medieval architecture, renowned cuisine, and Douro Valley hiking. Budget-friendly with authentic cultural experiences.

destinations.name: Krakow
destinations.rationale: Well-preserved medieval Old Town, traditional Polish food, and Tatra Mountains for hiking. Very affordable on moderate budget.
